title: Kitchen Silicone Collapsible Funnel Set of 3,Small and Large,Flexible-Foldable-Cooking-Food-Grade Funnels for Filling Small or Mini Bottles,Perfume,Filling Capsules,Fry Oil Filter,Essential Oil,Spice
description:
About this item
【Material】：Soft and flexible silicone funnel made of food grade silicone,BPA free.Resistant to high temperature from -40℃ to 250℃,there is no need to worry that the funnel may damage your family's health.
【Design】：Mini-Collapsible-Flexible-Kitchen Funnel set.Telescopic folding design,easy to place,silica gel material wear-resistant fall.A long - necked funnel wide mouth leaks rapidly into the bottle without spilling.Two sizes give you more options.
【Considerate】：Considerate hook hole,can be conveniently placed on the hook,is conducive to saving space,folding height only 2cm,storage does not take up space.
【Cleaning】：Convenient for anyone in the family.Super easy to keep clean,even if there's no oil,simply rinse with warm water,add a little soap,or put it in the dishwasher.
【 Convenient 】：Suit your drawer!By simply folding the silicone funnel,it becomes flat and takes up less space than the long, bulky metal or plastic funnel.You can even put these foldable funnels in your wallet or bag.
